Geospatial Data Engineer — 3D digital twins, cadastral systems & spatial ETL

View Projects Resume

docs.title: About
docs.text: I build geospatial pipelines and 3D visualization systems that turn raw survey, LiDAR, and municipal parcel data into interactive tools county and state government teams actually use — from CityJSON building models served as OGC 3D Tiles, to automated ETL that keeps property and infrastructure data current without manual re-processing.

docs.title: Projects
docs.text:
• 3D Cadastral Pipeline

    CityJSON → FME → OGC 3D Tiles → CesiumJS. County-scale building models, color-styled by height and year built, with click-to-inspect parcel attributes.

    Case study

  • Spatial ETL Pipeline

    Automated batch geoprocessing and API integrations — raw source data to cloud-ready formats (GeoParquet, 3D Tiles) on a schedule.

    Case study

  • Interactive Analytics Map

    Embedded map application over spatial queries and raster/vector processing notebooks, built for non-GIS stakeholders.

    Case study

  • System Architecture

    Data flow and database schema design for a multi-source geospatial platform — CLI tooling, PostGIS, and cloud storage conversions.

    Case study

  • Reality Capture Workflow

    LiDAR point cloud → mesh → web-ready 3D Tileset. Photogrammetry and building footprint extraction for as-built documentation.

    Case study

docs.title: Pipeline
docs.text:
graph LR
    A[CityJSON source data] --> B[FME: geometry cleanup, attribute joins, EPSG:6634 to WGS84]
    B --> C[3D Tiles export via Cesium ion]
    C --> D[CesiumJS viewer: attribute-driven styling]
  1. CityJSON source data ingested and validated
  2. FME workbench: geometry cleanup, attribute joins, coordinate transform (EPSG:6634 → WGS84)
  3. Export to 3D Tiles (Cesium ion pipeline)
  4. Served through CesiumJS with attribute-driven styling

Running this yourself

The viewer above needs a Cesium ion access token scoped to this asset — append ?token=YOUR_TOKEN to the iframe's src, or set window.CESIUM_ION_TOKEN before the page's script runs. Scope the token to this one asset ID in the Cesium ion dashboard before publishing; a client-side token restricted this way is the supported pattern for public CesiumJS demos — it is not a server secret.

The CesiumJS Bootcamp Viewer above needs a Cesium ion access token scoped to asset 5834028 — append ?token=YOUR_TOKEN to the iframe's src above, or set window.CESIUM_ION_TOKEN before the page's script runs.
